notes: AQY28xEH(A) and AQY28xS lifecycle is inferred: Panasonic removed them from its site (product pages 404, not in current series or discontinued-product database) but published no EOL notice I could find; they were still in production for the 2021 marking PCN (PCN.PG01.11.17.2021). Treat 'Obsolete' as likely, not documented.
AQY28xEH/S data come from 2003 datasheets, the newest obtainable; values may differ slightly from the last revision (Mouser's ASCTB353E 2014 SOP4 sheet was bot-blocked).
AQY282S and AQY282GS are different parts on different datasheets (0.5A/2.5Ohm vs 0.8A/0.8Ohm).
Panasonic SMD DIP land pattern (8.3mm row centres) is wider than KiCad SMDIP-x_W7.62mm (7.62mm); marked 'close'.
off_capacitance null throughout: Panasonic tabulates only I/O capacitance (1.5pF max); output capacitance appears as graphs only.
